scripts.install-all: npm run install-client && npm run install-server
scripts.build: cd client/azuretrain_portal && npm run build && cd ../../  && cp -r client/azuretrain_portal/build server/public
scripts.build-windows: cd client/azuretrain_portal && npm run build && cd ../../ && npm run copy-window
scripts.start-window: npm run install-all && npm run build-windows && cd server && npm start
scripts.start: npm run install-all && npm run build && cd server && npm start
